confirmation_sequence.question: Trusted exclusive-operation model or resistance to a hostile root process changing files concurrently?
confirmation_sequence.interpretation: Assistant explicitly interpreted this as the trusted exclusive-operation model in the next question.

confirmation_sequence.question: Stop after obtaining the two config hashes and removing only the temporary helper?
Confirm the complete design: stage pinned helper, read identities once, remove only helper after termination/identity verification, stop on failure; design only, no execution permission?

trust_model: Protect against mistakes, unexpected files, symlinks and stale identities. Assume exclusive owner-controlled operation, with no privileged process deliberately replacing files concurrently.
operation: Use cable-connected SSH. Create a new root-only helper directory; refuse an occupied path. Transfer the pinned ARM64 reader and verify its hash. Do not overwrite existing files or repair their permissions.
Invoke the reader once. Obtain only the two config hashes and approved metadata. Keep existing no-symlink, ownership, bounded-read and identity checks. Never print or copy config values.
After process termination is established, verify helper identity and remove only the new helper and proven-empty directory. If process state or identity is uncertain, preserve them.
On failure, stop without retry, widened investigation or service restart. Older experiment cleanup needs a separate fixed manifest and approval.

policy_supersession.replaced_requirement: Separate descriptor-safe staging/removal executor and descriptor-preserving deployment execution prerequisite.
policy_supersession.retained: Reader safeguards, fixed targets and helper paths, actual binary pin, bounded cable transport, single invocation, failure stop, and separate execution/deletion permission boundaries.

next_prerequisite: Prepare and review a concrete deployment script under this trust model. Obtain exact owner execution approval before any tablet connection. Do not create another general capability-discovery task.
publication: Repository-local design records. No phase receipt, implementation claim, commit, push or device execution implied.
